action_timeline.rationale: Correct the reported SP_NOT_READY conflict; first readiness is frame 2505.
Prioritize upper healing while Ansel sustains Noir Corne.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: No scheduled hostile spawn; no interception assigned.
Steward, GALLUS² and Durin supply ordinary arts damage. Remove the patrol before Steward's fixed withdrawal; survival and attack allocation are unverified.

Fang damages the eastern upper roadblock and Melantha the western upper roadblock. Upper outer interception separates officers from the restrained civilian. Ordinary operators neither attack nor block the civilian.
Plume hands upper central blocking to Cardigan. Lancet-2 bridges healing until Hibiscus joins. Lava supplies permanent armor damage after frame 4935.
Noir Corne hands lower central blocking to Beagle. Ansel heals from frame 3270. Durin and Lava supply arts damage against armor and accumulated enemies.
Fang handles the opening upper outer enemies. Melantha handles subsequent officers, receives Hibiscus healing and retains western roadblock clearance responsibility.
Friston-3 catches the opening lower outer raider and hands it to Midnight at frame 1305. Midnight retains two-block interception and later receives Ansel healing.

Durin damages the eastern lower roadblock and Midnight the western lower roadblock. Seek clearance before the civilian's frame-3030 spawn; actual destruction must precede dangerous officer proximity. Do not assume a clearance duration.

Economical lower central holder through the physician-first transition.
Opening upper outer interception, eastern upper roadblock damage and two automatic DP grants.
Temporary lower outer blocking until Midnight's direct replacement.
Opening global heal and upper healing bridge; remain alongside Hibiscus until Lava needs this tile.
Permanent lower outer interception and western lower roadblock damage.
Patrol damage across the eastern vertical circuit.
Supplementary ordinary arts damage across the lower eastern circuit.
Eastern lower roadblock damage, upper eastern patrol coverage and permanent lower central arts damage.
Western upper roadblock damage and subsequent upper outer officer interception.
Baseline range covers the lower central holder, Midnight and Durin.
Baseline range covers the upper central holder, Melantha and the upper ranged tile.
Permanent lower central three-block replacement before armored pressure.
Permanent arts damage reaching both central blocking tiles; no splash contribution assumed.
Permanent upper central three-block replacement before paired late raiders; physician healing required.

formation_structure.exposure_limit: Physician placement and earlier healing do not establish immunity to artillery. Confirmed patrol removal remains necessary.
formation_structure.final: Cardigan, Beagle, Melantha and Midnight hold four corridors. Hibiscus and Ansel heal their assigned formations. Lava covers both central lanes and Durin supports the lower lane.
formation_structure.healing_transition: Ansel enters at 109 seconds. After Steward leaves, Hibiscus enters at 116 seconds without removing Lancet-2. Noir Corne retains lower blocking under Ansel until Beagle's 134.5-second handoff.
formation_structure.opening: Plume and Noir Corne hold the central lanes. Fang holds the upper outer lane. Friston-3 catches the lower outer raider until Midnight replaces him. Lancet-2 supports the upper holders.
formation_structure.patrol_battery: Steward covers the eastern vertical circuit, GALLUS² its lower section and Durin its upper section. Actual attack allocation remains subject to current-model targeting; no forced patrol priority is assumed.

formation_transitions.transition: Retreat Friston-3, then deploy Midnight on the same tile without an intervening action.
Retreat Fang after the expected frame-2040 second DP grant; budget no later Fang income.
Melantha takes permanent upper outer responsibility and attacks the western upper roadblock.
Retreat GALLUS² and deploy Ansel; Steward and Durin retain patrol damage responsibility.
Retreat Steward. Patrol death must already be confirmed; otherwise this fixed candidate fails its patrol invariant.
Deploy Hibiscus alongside Lancet-2. Ansel supports Noir Corne while the defender upgrade waits.
Retreat Noir Corne, then deploy Beagle on the same lower central tile.
Retreat Lancet-2, then deploy Lava on the vacated upper ranged tile.
Retreat Plume, then deploy Cardigan before late paired upper central raiders.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Every selected operator belongs to normal_low_star_catalog, has identity.rarity between 1 and 3 and qualification.normal_mode true. Exclude mode-specific reserves.
Every DEPLOY uses integer [row,col], a legal terrain tile and UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT. Never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
Execute the listed actions in order, including retreat before replacement at equal frames. A failed prerequisite invalidates this candidate; deterministic tooling must not change tactical actions.
Use initial 10 DP, modeled natural recovery and only Fang's two conditional +6 grants. Count no retreat refunds, Plume kill income or other unsupported income. Static minimum DP is 0.
At most eight operators are deployed. Required holders survive until their stated retreats; replacements preserve corridor coverage.
Battery operators must remain effective long enough to kill enemy_1112_emppnt#0 before frame 3420. Neither self-healing nor placement alone proves artillery survival.
Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians. Damage the designated roadblocks and intercept hostile officers; do not rely on civilian target priority or healing.
Confirm both restraint pairs are destroyed before restrained civilians suffer lethal officer or artillery pressure. Device HP, target order and exact destruction frames are not established.
Ansel's baseline range covers the lower trio; Hibiscus's covers the upper holder, Melantha and Lava. Cardigan receives ordinary physician healing without self-heal credit.
Claim WIN only with remaining_life > 0, zero enemy leaks, exhausted spawns and no active enemies. The last modeled spawn at frame 6330 is not itself completion.

pressure_window_responsibilities.responsibility: Establish all four opening interception duties and deploy Lancet-2 after the central holders have begun taking damage.
Complete the lower outer handoff, establish the patrol battery and preserve Fang through both budgeted DP grants.
Establish Melantha, damage both civilian restraint pairs, remove the patrol and introduce Ansel while preserving every remaining corridor holder.

Introduce Hibiscus early, retain Lancet-2 as overlapping upper healing and let Ansel sustain Noir Corne until Beagle replaces him. Protect the second civilian from restraint-associated officer pressure.
Replace Lancet-2 with Lava and Plume with Cardigan. Use permanent arts damage and three-block central holders against armor and paired raiders.

Continue all final blocking, attacks and healing through residual armor and outer officers. Retain the formation after the listed skills until remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns and no active enemies are all confirmed.

skill_intents.intent: Budget exactly two +6 DP grants while Fang survives and remains deployed. Effective deployment cost is 10 from the supported self-cost reduction.
Use supported ATK and attack-speed increases for opening officer clearance and the first armored window; assume no kill DP or unsupported talent bonus.

Use the supported ATK increase for roadblock and officer damage. Deployment at 43.5 seconds requires preparation until 83.5; activate at 84. After 40 active seconds and 70 recovery seconds, activate again at 195. No unevidenced damage conversion is required.
Increase damage during later outer officer pressure and extended cleanup.
Increase lower healing. Assigned allies are already in baseline range; no probabilistic extra healing is counted.
Support upper armor, late raider pressure and cleanup with the supported healing ATK increase.
Increase DEF during late central pressure and any extended cleanup.
Use the supported deployment SP bonus and attack-speed skill; count ordinary single-target arts damage without splash.
Allow automatic attack-SP enhanced attacks; do not assume highest-defense target priority.
Assign no unsupported self-healing skill; depend on Hibiscus.

tactical_thesis: Retain four purposeful opening interceptions and the eastern patrol battery, correct Midnight's preparation and recharge timing, then prioritize upper healing over an early defender upgrade. Hibiscus joins at 116 seconds while Ansel sustains Noir Corne until Beagle replaces him at 134.5 seconds. Lancet-2 remains until Lava's deployment. This fixed, untested candidate depends on battery survival, patrol removal before 114 seconds and timely civilian roadblock clearance.
